The decisive mistake was made by **ISBNCheckDigit_Expert** at **step 0**. It asserted that the Tropicos ID for Order Helotiales is 8200000 without retrieving it from any source. No later step could have produced the correct answer of 3 from that ID. Under the plan's weighting (positions 1 to 9, mod 11), 8200000 yields X or 0. The standard ISBN-10 weightings also don't give 3, so the ID itself must be wrong. The later errors were real, but they only compounded this one. VerificationExpert's manual check at step 4 padded the ID incorrectly (082000000 instead of 008200000), and its "correction" to 0 overrode the code's correct X output. Those mistakes never fix the wrong input, though.
